title: admin HTTP endpoints: fail-closed bearer token enforcement
description: Transit (transit/admin.rs) and Sieve (smtp/sieve_admin.rs) admin APIs already have bearer token middleware — it just isn't required. Fix: refuse to start if listen addr is non-loopback and bearer_token is None. Fail-closed, not warn-and-continue. Affect both transit and sieve admin. Also replace the non-constant-time string comparison in transit/admin.rs:296-303 with subtle::ConstantTimeEq or equivalent (fixes 5w3.34). These are ~10 lines of change total but the current warn-only behavior is a footgun in production.
